Audit and integrity

Guidance and coursework scope

How booking works

Find a space → apply → staff assessment → demo payment → confirmation.

Customer journey

  1. Select a facility and a future time, including setup and cleanup.
  2. Enter event details, confirm age and privacy, and upload required evidence.
  3. Review your request. Sign in before submitting or saving a draft.
  4. Open My bookings for staff questions, replies and amendment requests.
  5. After approval, use the demo checkout. Download your receipt and calendar file.

Staff roles

Coordinators assess evidence and decide applications. Customer Service enters applications on behalf of a hirer. Finance authorises waivers/refunds and reconciles provider references. Administrators configure facilities and access. Auditors review integrity and reports.

Staff verify a second authentication factor. Demo mode shows a test code; normal mode uses your authenticator app.

Privacy and assistance

Use invented names and documents in this coursework system. Accounts, contact details, application records and evidence are retained in your local database until the operator disposes of it. Customer Service can enter the same record for a caller. Use your profile to correct contact details.

Use Tab to navigate, Enter/Space to activate controls, and Escape to close dialogs. All event times are in Australia/Darwin. Status is always shown as text.

What is simulated?

The gateway authorises demo transactions and creates references, but never charges money. Email/SMS delivery, insurance authenticity and Council/finance connections are not external integrations. The report’s performance, availability, recovery and WCAG targets still require independent evidence; this demonstration does not establish those production certifications.

Refunds and amendments require staff approval. Evidence verification is a human decision. Rates, capacities, equipment and rules are example configuration.
